reason_a: perceptual_lpips.py compute crashes at dump_json(SUMMARY, ...) with TypeError: Object of type bool is not JSON serializable, because scipy 1.16.3 binomtest().pvalue is numpy.float64 and `p < ALPHA` in sign_test yields numpy.bool (RUN_NOTES.md §5). Fix in perceptual_lpips_v2.py: cast p to float and `significant` to bool in sign_test, and give dump_json a default that converts np.generic via .item(). Values unchanged; only Python types.
reason_b: The cached torchvision checkpoint ~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/vgg16-397923af.pth is truncated (155,730,036 of 553,433,881 bytes; sha256 8bdcf25e… does not begin with 397923af), so lpips.LPIPS(net='vgg') raises RuntimeError: unexpected EOF (RUN_NOTES.md §2).
